# Bradley Matera — Small Business Web Design

> Fast, accessible, locally optimized websites built directly by Bradley Matera, with transparent pricing, measurable deliverables, no long contract, and no agency handoff. Based in Durand, Illinois. Serving Northwest Illinois and Southern Wisconsin.

## Key Facts

- Business type: Solo web developer serving small businesses
- Location: Durand, Illinois (Northwest Illinois)
- Service radius: Rockford, Freeport, Loves Park, Belvidere, Beloit WI, Janesville WI
- Starting price: $447 for a one-page website
- No long-term contracts required
- Client owns all code, content, domain, and hosting
- 50% deposit, 50% on launch
- Typical timeline: 2-4 weeks for a 5-page site
- Platforms: Gatsby (static), WordPress, custom HTML/CSS/JS
- Accessibility target: WCAG 2.2 AA
